importantFindings.title: Still open, now non-blocking: no invariant check catches two active courses on one device
importantFindings.evidence: validateCourseState checks one course snapshot and does not run on downloaded rows. The two-course state can no longer be reached through the UI paths tested (the awaiting mark blocks creating and importing); if it arose another way only bindCourseSession's generic open failure would notice. The live restore now carries crews, a member, land and an evaluation and compares every exported table row for row.

qolFindings.title: An emptied device that signed out while waiting cannot create or import a course without the account or a full reset
qolFindings.evidence: Fake backend: restoring, 'Esci dall’account', reload: signed-out, both buttons disabled, the mark kept; the screen explains why; the only way out without signing in is 'Azzera tutti i dati locali'. Safe by design.

qolFindings.title: A device switched empty before b08545b has no awaiting mark
qolFindings.evidence: The mark is written only inside the switch; a test device that switched empty on the round-1 build may still create a course while the account's is on its way; the App's reopen on arrival cannot undo it. Test devices of the round-1 build only.
